remarks: Recently renovated 2-bedroom residence offering modern finishes and exceptional convenience in a prime mid-city location. The updated kitchen features contemporary cabinetry and finishes, complemented by newer wood-look tile flooring throughout the main living areas and Berber carpeting in the bedrooms. Updated bath and entire unit professionally painted creating a crisp, move-in-ready feel. A spacious and sun-filled layout provides abundant closet space and opens to a large private terrace. Two A/C units come with the unit. Rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, basic cable, trash removal, snow removal, and one reserved parking space. Community amenities feature a fitness center, playground, laundry facilities, 24-hour security, and an outdoor pool. Ideally situated just steps to downtown Stamford, with easy access to shopping, dining, and transportation. A turnkey opportunity to enjoy updated living in an unbeatable location.
